newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Yemeni appeals court rules that a man who shot dead six people and injured 11 be executed and his body nailed on a cross for three days.
- Saudi billionaire Prince al-Waleed purchases five percent of Apple shares for $115 million.
- National banks in the United Arab Emirates post $625 million net profits in 1996.
- Sudanese foreign minister says more effort needed to improve Sudanese-Egyptian relations.
- United Arab Emirates to send more food assistance to Iraq.
- United Saudi Commercial Bank posts a 91.4 million riyal net profit in the first quarter of 1996.
- Planning minister of United Arab Emirates expects gross domestic product to reach 171 billion dirhams in 1997.
